body:
@weizijun thank you for submitting this issue. 

I am not sure I understand the problem here. 

Also, in the example you mention I see that there are duplicate documents for [_tsid:1, timestamp: 1] and [_tsid:3, timestamp: 1] . 

It would be great if you could submit a test that reproduces this problem.
